verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS platform that ships SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking for Klaviyo's app, SDKs or MCP server. The event-tracking and SDK material describes tracking customer behavior, which is not a user opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
